Contact us

Defeat Attacks

Advanced prevention, detection, and response technologies built to protect against container attacks.

Consolidated Workload Security

Comprehensive threat and attack visibility for all containers and workloads across your extended environment.

Flexible Multi-distribution Protection

Eliminate Linux security compatibility challenges with kernel-agnostic security.

Comprehensive Linux and Container Security

GravityZone Security for Containers protects container workloads from modern Linux and container-based threats by leveraging advanced AI-driven threat prevention, specialized Linux anti-exploit technologies, and context-aware detection and response.

 

With unified visibility and control, GravityZone Security for Containers ensures consistent protection for containers and workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

Capabilities and Benefits

Consolidated Security

GravityZone Security for Containers is part of the comprehensive GravityZone security platform, which provides unified visibility and control across all workloads.

 

Actionable Outcomes

Attack forensics and visualization enhance the level of visibility into your organization’s threat landscape and reveals the broader context of attacks on containers. Zero in on specific threats and take corrective action.

Purpose Built Protection

Leverage cutting-edge exploit prevention technologies to protect vulnerable applications from advanced threats.

 

Sophisticated mechanisms monitor memory access routines to detect and block exploit techniques like process hijacking, container escapes, malicious scripting, and other sophisticated attack methods, ensuring robust defense against evolving threats.

Architected for Performance

Without the need for kernel components, new distributions can be deployed without making security a constraint. This ensures minimal resource impact to simplify operations and improves cloud return-on-investment.

 

Defeat Threats

Sophisticated defenses combine behavioral monitoring and zero-day protection, mapping container attacks to the MITRE ATT&CK® Framework. Gain focus on Linux-specific threats with detailed, context-rich insights.

Technology & Architecture

GravityZone Security for Containers combines with Cloud and Server Security to deliver robust Cloud Workload Security as part of consolidated Cloud Native Security.

Schedule a Demo

  • Multi-layered Protection

    Advanced antivirus, antimalware, behavioral monitoring, and zero-day protection to prevent, detect, and neutralize evasive exploits and targeted attacks.

  • Attack Forensics

    Enhanced visualization provides deep insights into your threat landscape, revealing the context of container attacks and enabling precise threat identification and corrective action.

  • Secure Linux and Containers

    Provides native deployment options for Linux- PaaS-hosted containers with a host-based agent and container-native telemetry, ensuring robust protection across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Advanced Protection

    Blocks memory and application exploits by monitoring memory access and stopping techniques like process hijacking, container escape methods, and malicious scripts.

FAQ

What container infrastructures are supported?

GravityZone Security for Containers supports containers running on:

· Docker

· Podman

· Kubernetes

· Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS)

· Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS)

· Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

· Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

Support for new container platforms is being added regularly, please check with your sales or partner representative for the latest list.

How is this different from other Linux and Container security solutions?

Bitdefender has developed a modern attack detection and response security stack for Linux servers and containers that is highly differentiated from existing solutions through its security efficacy, incident fidelity, and multi-distribution workload compatibility.

 

Our design is platform-independent with no reliance on Linux Kernel modules, allowing a single agent to support multiple Linux and container distributions. DevSecOps teams can confidently upgrade Linux workloads without adversely affecting security.

Is there a way to see a demo before contacting Bitdefender?

We have a wide variety of self-guided demos available on Demo Zone.
